context:
Goal: the work goes on now, and you can overrule any coordinator pick.
Problem (goal): the coordinator took this undoable pick on Nov 12, 12:51 CST without asking you; it stands unless you choose b.
Based on (ruling): rules building-never-drop-item-silently (never drop an item without saying so) and shared-trees-archive-then-delete (save a branch to an archive copy before deleting it), cited by the coordinator.
Departs from: main has no such pick on record — 19 old claude-settings PRs are checked one by one before any closes.

options.gain: No change is lost, and every old PR that is fully covered goes away.
options.how: The PR backlog lane compares each of the 19 old claude-settings PRs with main and with the PR that replaced it. It closes one only when every change is elsewhere, after saving its branch as an archive copy; the rest stay open with their missing files listed. Undo: reopen.
options.label: Keep the pick (Recommended)
options.lose: The other route is not taken unless you choose b.

options.how: Leave all 19 open until you look at them.
options.label: Overrule it
options.lose: 19 old PRs keep cluttering the list.

short: Old PRs close only when nothing is lost
title: An old PR closes only when every change it holds is already elsewhere
why: A coordinator pick you could not see before.
